skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — add a natural-sounding English voiceover that matches the on-screen action...

latestVersion.changelog:
Voiceover AI 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly add AI-generated, natural-sounding English voiceovers to your videos (up to 500MB)
- Simple workflow: upload video, describe your desired voiceover, and get processed results in under a minute
- Automatic cloud-based processing with seamless session management (no software to install)
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, and other popular formats
- Includes helpful error handling, usage tips, and workflow guidance for creators, marketers, and educators
- Secure anonymous token workflow with 100 free credits for new users
